content: प्रश्नः [प्रच्छ्-भावे नङ्] .²1 A question, query; an inquiry, interrogation (अविज्ञातप्रवचनं प्रश्न इत्यभिधीयते); अनामयप्रश्नपूर्वकम् <ls>Ś. 5</ls> ‘with an inquiry about (your) well-being or health’. .²2 A judicial inquiry or investigation. .²3 A point at issue, a subject of controversy, controverted or disputed point; इति प्रश्न उपस्थितः. .²4 A problem for solution or calculation; अहं ते प्रश्नं दास्यामि <ls>Mk.</ls> .²5 Inquiry into the future. .²6 A short section of a work. .²7 Basket-work. .²8 A task or lesson (in Vedic recitation).
